justification: Buffer overflow in toBigIntLE() when called with attacker-controlled lengths. AgentGuard only passes fixed-size slices from SPL account layouts it decodes itself; no network-controlled length reaches the function. No upstream fix exists for @solana/web3.js 1.x; revisit when migrating to @solana/kit.

package: zod@3 (packages/policy only; packages/api is on zod 4.6.7)
justification: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. Policy files are operator-supplied from disk at startup, never request input; request validation in packages/api runs on zod 4.6.7 behind a 64 KiB body limit. Action: policy package owner to upgrade to zod 4.
